result.summary: Found 2 major issues: truncated content in the restaurant cards section and cut-off category filter pills that suggest incomplete visibility.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' section is horizontally cut off, showing only partial content. The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' appears truncated and the full card is not visible.
issues.suggestion: Ensure all cards are fully visible within the viewport or implement proper horizontal scrolling behavior. Consider reducing card width or adjusting container padding to fit three complete cards visibly.

issues.description: The category filter pills at the top extend beyond the visible area. After 'Healthy', there is a partially cut-off pill that is not fully visible, suggesting incomplete or hidden filter options.
issues.suggestion: Either display all category pills with proper spacing, or implement a horizontal scroll mechanism with visual indicators (scroll arrows) to show users there are more categories available.
